title: Drone Airspace Restriction Map — Abuja
desc: Interactive map of NCAA/NAMA-style airspace restriction zones for drone operators in Nigeria. Leaflet/GeoJSON frontend built with a data-provider architecture designed for a future FastAPI + PostGIS backend.

title: Climate Risk Lens
desc: Neighborhood-scale heat and flood exposure explorer with composite risk scores and plain-language AI summaries.

title: Akwa Ibom Tourism Platform
desc: Destination-marketing platform scaling my BSc TourUyo project into a full tourism platform for Akwa Ibom State, modeled on visitestonia.com.

title: GHDI: Multi-Variate Drought Index for the Greater Horn of Africa
desc: Developed the GHDI — a probabilistic copula-based drought index integrating GRACE TWS, precipitation, evapotranspiration, and soil moisture. Validated using FEWS NET and compared with SPI and ENSO across timescales.

title: Delft3D FM Ocean Model Validation Framework
desc: Built a validation framework for Delft3D Flexible Mesh ocean models using in situ data. Processed and visualised hydrodynamic datasets, and integrated geospatial workflows into modelling pipelines at Deltares, Delft.

title: Enterprise Geospatial Database & Network Routing — ipNX Nigeria
desc: Designed and optimised enterprise geospatial databases. Implemented network routing optimisation for fibre optic infrastructure across Nigeria.

title: Geospatially Africa Podcast
desc: Founded and host a podcast platform showcasing African and global geospatial innovations. Built and maintained the website using Django, HTML, CSS, and PostgreSQL.

title: TourUyo: Web-based GIS Tourism System for Uyo City
desc: Designed a web-based tourism information system for Uyo Metropolis using QGIS and Leaflet. Demonstrates spatial data integration for urban tourism planning.

title: Geohazard Risk Mapping — Lead Flood Analyst
desc: Lead flood analyst for the Geohazard Risk Mapping Initiative. Volunteer GIS analysis for URISA GISCorps and GIS-E across humanitarian and development contexts.
